name: Xanterra Travel Collection
desc:
Customer Service & Sales Reservation Agent | Est. $17/hr plus monthly incentives | Inbound Calls and Chats, Light Sales (Recommending and Selling Trips)
Company: Xanterra Travel Collection
Industry: Hospitality and Tourism

What a typical day will look like:
You work from home and talk with guests by inbound phone calls and chats who are planning trips to national parks like Yellowstone, Grand Canyon South Rim, Glacier, Death Valley, and Custer State Park. You answer questions, explain the options, and help guests book rooms and experiences. You also recommend activities and trips that fit what each guest wants, so this is customer service with some selling mixed in. You learn several computer systems and work on your own in a quiet home workspace. As you learn the products, you can move into a sales-focused setup with a monthly uncapped incentive program.

Soft Skills
- Friendly, professional communication
- Active listening
- Willingness to learn
- Staying focused while working independently
- Comfort with talking about options and making recommendations
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: None listed. The posting says you do not need to know the reservation system or destinations on day one.
Preferred Experience: None listed

Required Skills:
- Schedule flexibility, including working until 8:15 PM Central and on weekends
- Friendly, professional, helpful attitude
- Comfort with both customer service and sales
- Strong communication skills
- Able to stay focused and organized while working alone at home
- Quiet, dedicated work space with no distractions
- Hardwired high-speed internet, at least 40 Mbps download
- Comfortable learning and using several computer systems
- Willing to pass a pre-employment drug screen and background check

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Loves travel and the outdoors and likes helping people plan trips
- Has customer service, retail, or hospitality experience
- Is comfortable recommending products and talking about options
- Wants a paid 3 week training and room to grow into incentive pay

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Does not want any sales in their job
- Cannot work evenings or weekends
- Does not have wired internet or a quiet workspace
- Needs a set 9 to 5 schedule
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening goes, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Customer service
- Reservations
- Inbound calls and chat
- Sales and upselling
- Travel and hospitality
- Guest experience
- Multi-system navigation
- Product knowledge
- Working independently
- Attendance and reliability

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Why do you want to help guests plan trips to national parks?
- How comfortable are you recommending products or experiences to customers?
- How do you stay focused and organized when you work from home?
- Tell us about a time you helped a customer find the right solution. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you learned something new quickly. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: Est. $17/hr, range $16 to $20/hr. Pay isn't listed in the posting. Salary site data for similar Xanterra reservation agent roles shows about $14 to $17/hr in one estimate and about $18 to $22.60/hr in another, so this is a working estimate. There is also a monthly uncapped incentive program for people who move into a sales-focused setup, plus extra incentives for perfect attendance and referrals. Exact pay will be discussed in interview/offer stage.
-Shift: Must be able to work until 8:15 PM Central and on weekends. Exact hours are discussed in the final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision, HSA and FSA, life and disability, accident, hospital, and critical illness coverage, pet insurance, PTO and paid holidays, 401(k) with company match, Employee Assistance Plan, education assistance, and employee discounts and travel deals.
-Equipment Provided: Yes, company-provided computer equipment.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions. The posting lists a pre-employment drug screen and background check.
-Notes: Fully remote and Oklahoma is listed as an eligible state. Training is 3 weeks, paid. The posting hires full-time and part-time, and this listing is full-time year-round. Hardwired internet of at least 40 Mbps is required, so Wi-Fi alone will not work. This role includes sales. You recommend and sell trips, and the incentive pay comes from that. Camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Customer Service & Sales Reservation Agent → Senior Reservation Agent → Reservations Team Lead → Reservations Supervisor → Central Reservations Manager. This role builds booking, product knowledge, customer service, and consultative sales skills.
training: 3 weeks paid new hire training, schedule discussed in interview/offer stage
